'''Omega''' (Japanese: '''オメガ''' ''Omega'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]''. He participated in the [[Club Battle]] tournament, but lost in a battle against [[Dino]] and was knocked out of the very first round.
